achievements.title: 妖鬼狂言百物语
achievements.description: 集齐全套《鹮巷物语》。
achievements.description_en: Collect the entire "Toki Alley Tales" series.

achievements.title: 动物园大亨
achievements.description: 使用道具「四方八方之网」捕获1只野外生物。
achievements.description_en: Use the Omni-Ubiquity Net item to capture 1 wild animal.

achievements.title: 动物园大亨
achievements.description: 使用道具「四方八方之网」捕获30只野外生物。
achievements.description_en: Use the Omni-Ubiquity Net item to capture 30 wild animals.

achievements.title: 动物园大亨
achievements.description: 使用道具「四方八方之网」捕获100只野外生物。
achievements.description_en: Use the Omni-Ubiquity Net item to capture 100 wild animals.

achievements.title: 昨日重现
achievements.description: 通过「千籁至音」系列摆设在尘歌壶内激活10首旋律。
achievements.description_en: Activate 10 tunes in the Serenitea Pot using the Euphonium Unbound furnishing series.

achievements.title: 昨日重现
achievements.description: 通过「千籁至音」系列摆设在尘歌壶内激活30首旋律。
achievements.description_en: Activate 30 tunes in the Serenitea Pot using the Euphonium Unbound furnishing series.

achievements.title: 昨日重现
achievements.description: 通过「千籁至音」系列摆设在尘歌壶内激活60首旋律。
achievements.description_en: Activate 60 tunes in the Serenitea Pot using the Euphonium Unbound furnishing series.

achievements.title: 俯瞰风景
achievements.description: 抵达庆云顶的制高点。
achievements.description_en: Reach the very top of Qingyun Peak.

achievements.title: 烈风的遗骨
achievements.description: 登上风龙废墟的高塔顶端。
achievements.description_en: Reach the top of the tower in Stormterror's Lair.

achievements.title: 「风带来了故事的种子…」
achievements.title_en: "Seeds of Stories, Brought by the Wind..."
achievements.description: 到达蒙德东北方的无名小岛。
achievements.description_en: Reach the nameless island northeast of Mondstadt.
achievements.series_master_title_en: "Seeds of Stories, Brought by the Wind..."

achievements.title: 矢志不渝
achievements.description: 开启爱心形石阵中央的宝箱。
achievements.description_en: Open the chest in the middle of the heart-shaped rock formation.

achievements.title: 启动跃迁引擎！
achievements.description: 穿越誓言岬上空的时空隧道。
achievements.description_en: Pass through the time tunnel in the skies of Cape Oath.

achievements.title: 风神的宠儿
achievements.description: 在蒙德城内的神像手中坐下。
achievements.description_en: Take a seat in the hands of the God Statue in Mondstadt.

achievements.title: 冢里最好的剑
achievements.title_en: The Best Sword in the Cemetery
achievements.description: 解开剑冢的三层封印。
achievements.description_en: Unlock the Tri-Seal of the Sword Cemetery.
achievements.series_master_title_en: The Best Sword in the Cemetery

achievements.title: 华清归藏密宫
achievements.description: 循着长存者之迹，叩开了秘境之门。
achievements.description_en: Follow in the footsteps of immortals, and unlock the Domain's door.

achievements.title: 塞西莉亚苗圃
achievements.description: 帮助仙灵归位，解锁奔狼领内的秘境入口。
achievements.description_en: Return the Seelie to their rightful places and unlock the entrance to a Domain in Wolvendom.

achievements.title: 无妄引咎密宫
achievements.description: 跟随仙灵点燃火光，解锁无妄坡内的秘境入口。
achievements.description_en: Follow the Seelie and light the torches to unlock the entrance to a domain in Wuwang Hill.

achievements.title: 「只要用心…」
achievements.title_en: "If you put your heart into it..."
achievements.description: 烹饪1道口味奇怪的料理。
achievements.description_en: Cook 1 suspicious-tasting dish.
achievements.series_master_title_en: "If you put your heart into it..."

achievements.title: 「…人人都是食神。」
achievements.description: 烹饪10道口味奇怪的料理。
achievements.description_en: Cook 10 suspicious-tasting dishes.

achievements.title: 十岁差点打倒野猪
achievements.description: 被野猪击败。
achievements.description_en: Be defeated by a wild boar.

achievements.title: 金牌飞行执照
achievements.description: 一次滑翔很远、很远的距离。
achievements.description_en: Glide a long, long distance in one go.

achievements.title: 「在空中飞行程度的能力」
achievements.title_en: It's the Same As Having Wings
achievements.description: 持续滑翔超过80秒。
achievements.description_en: Glide continuously for over 80s.
achievements.series_master_title_en: It's the Same As Having Wings

achievements.title: 如光似电
achievements.description: 持续冲刺或使用替代冲刺的能力，移动15秒。
achievements.description_en: Sprint continuously (or use an alternative sprint) for over 15s.

achievements.title: 朋友遍天下
achievements.description: 在冒险中，与各种各样的人相识。
achievements.description_en: Meet all sorts of people during your adventure.

achievements.title: 威遍风土
achievements.description: 蒙德的声望等级达到8级。
achievements.description_en: Reach Reputation Lv. 8 in Mondstadt.

achievements.title: 名震云来
achievements.description: 璃月的声望等级达到8级。
achievements.description_en: Reach Reputation Lv. 8 in Liyue.

achievements.title: 布武雷国
achievements.description: 稻妻的声望等级达到10级。
achievements.description_en: Reach Reputation Lv. 10 in Inazuma.

achievements.title: QUEST CLEAR
achievements.description: 完成3次「讨伐悬赏」。
achievements.description_en: Complete 3 Bounties.

achievements.title: QUEST CLEAR
achievements.description: 完成6次「讨伐悬赏」。
achievements.description_en: Complete 6 Bounties.

achievements.title: QUEST CLEAR
achievements.description: 完成9次「讨伐悬赏」。
achievements.description_en: Complete 9 Bounties.

achievements.title: 见习勇者
achievements.description: 完成3次「居民请求」。
achievements.description_en: Complete 3 Requests.

achievements.title: 见习勇者
achievements.description: 完成6次「居民请求」。
achievements.description_en: Complete 6 Requests.

achievements.title: 见习勇者
achievements.description: 完成9次「居民请求」。
achievements.description_en: Complete 9 Requests.

achievements.title: QUEST FAILED  OR …
achievements.description: 在「讨伐悬赏」中跟丢了悬赏目标，或再也不用进行「讨伐悬赏」…
achievements.description_en: Lost track of the target during a Bounty, or no longer need to pursue Bounties at all...

achievements.title: 多冷的隆冬
achievements.description: 因为严寒而倒下…
achievements.description_en: Succumb to Sheer Cold...

achievements.title: 祭司、公主与记事者
achievements.description: 获得雪葬之都的宝物。
achievements.description_en: Claim the treasure of the Entombed City.

achievements.title: 逆子的归乡
achievements.description: 循着过去的考察队中某人的路径，抵达他启程返乡的地方。
achievements.description_en: Follow the path of one of the members of the long-lost investigation team to where they embarked on their journey home.

achievements.title: 千年雪藏的事
achievements.description: 了解过去一支雪山考察队的结局。
achievements.description_en: Discover the fate of a long-lost investigation team that once explored Dragonspine.

achievements.title: 冰冷的钢铁
achievements.description: 获得星银铸造的古代武器。
achievements.description_en: Obtain an ancient weapon made of Starsilver.

achievements.title: 无果的远征
achievements.description: 发现很多遗迹机器的遗骸…
achievements.description_en: Discover the remains of many ruin machines.

achievements.title: 没能讲出的故事
achievements.description: 在意想不到之处，结识了意想不到的朋友。
achievements.description_en: Make an unexpected friend in an unexpected location.

achievements.title: 一览众山小
achievements.description: 抵达龙脊雪山的最高峰。
achievements.description_en: Reach the summit of Dragonspine.

achievements.title: 一个冬天的童话
achievements.description: 在雪堆下发现了冰晶蝶。
achievements.description_en: Discover a Cryo Crystalfly beneath a snow pile.

achievements.title: 猎人变成了猎物
achievements.description: 被大雪猪王击败。
achievements.description_en: Be defeated by The Great Snowboar King.

achievements.title: 冷静点！
achievements.description: 击败处于狂暴状态下的大雪猪王。
achievements.description_en: Defeat The Great Snowboar King while the latter is in berserker mode.

achievements.title: 「一口吃掉了几十万摩拉！」
achievements.description: 掌握「稠汁蔬菜炖肉」的制作方法。
achievements.description_en: Learn to make Goulash.

achievements.title: 天雷圣裁
achievements.description: 被落雷击中。
achievements.description_en: Get struck by lightning.

achievements.title: 接近天空的地方…
achievements.description: 登上复原后的寒天之钉。
achievements.description_en: Climb the Skyfrost Nail after it has been restored.

achievements.title: 嬗变核素
achievements.description: 利用「参量质变仪」，完成一次物质质变。
achievements.description_en: Use the Parametric Transformer to complete one material transmutation.

achievements.title: …你其实听得见吧？
achievements.title_en: ...You could hear Paimon all along, couldn't you?
achievements.description: 派蒙也会累的。
achievements.description_en: Even Paimon gets tired sometimes.
achievements.series_master_title_en: ...You could hear Paimon all along, couldn't you?

achievements.title: 哟嚯嚯，再来瓶蒲公英酒
achievements.title_en: Yo-Ho-Ho, and a Bottle of Dandelion Wine
achievements.description: 登上「浪船」。
achievements.description_en: Climb aboard your Waverider.
achievements.series_master_title: 哟嚯嚯，再来瓶蒲公英酒
achievements.series_master_title_en: Yo-Ho-Ho, and a Bottle of Dandelion Wine

achievements.title: 「乘风破浪真君」
achievements.description: 持续搭乘「浪船」达到一定时间。
achievements.description_en: Continuously sail your Waverider for a certain period of time.

achievements.title: Nice boat!
achievements.description: 与其他玩家交换「浪船」。
achievements.description_en: Switch Waveriders with another player.

achievements.title: …其名为「玛丽·塞勒斯特」
achievements.title_en: ...And Her Name Is the Mary Celeste
achievements.description: 「浪船」被破坏了…
achievements.description_en: Suffer the destruction of your Waverider...
achievements.series_master_title_en: ...And Her Name Is the Mary Celeste

achievements.title: Deja Vu!
achievements.description: 持续高速行驶「浪船」达到一定时间。
achievements.description_en: Continuously sail your Waverider at high speeds for a certain period of time.

achievements.title: 山田五的木槌
achievements.description: 多次识破妖狸的法术。
achievements.description_en: See through the illusions of the Tanuki several times.

achievements.title: 「鲸井御殿流手鞠术」
achievements.description: 陪鲸井小弟玩「手鞠游戏」。
achievements.description_en: Play a game of Temari with Kujirai.

achievements.title: 本朝手鞠戏小传
achievements.description: 其他玩家参加了你所设置的「手鞠游戏」。
achievements.description_en: Have another player join a game of Temari that you are hosting.

achievements.title: 派蒙的幸运日！
achievements.description: 在鸣神大社，抽中「大吉」的签文。
achievements.description_en: Draw a "Great Fortune" fortune slip at the Grand Narukami Shrine.

achievements.title: 诸事不宜…
achievements.description: 在鸣神大社，抽中「大凶」的签文。
achievements.description_en: Draw a "Great Misfortune" slip at the Grand Narukami Shrine

achievements.title: 地宫传奇…才怪咧！
achievements.description: 发掘失落记忆的冒险本身，又何尝不是宝藏呢？
achievements.description_en: Sometimes, the real treasure is the things you learn along the way.

achievements.title: SYUUMATSU GAIDEN
achievements.description: 被卷入终末番与愚人众的战斗中…
achievements.description_en: Get caught up in the fight between the Shuumatsuban and the Fatui...

achievements.title: 岩藏武艺帐
achievements.description: 见证岩藏流的末路。
achievements.description_en: Witness the end of the Iwakura Clan.

achievements.title: 开门放狗
achievements.description: 解放寅太郎。
achievements.description_en: Set Toratarou free.

achievements.title: 情非得已
achievements.description: 打开广海的心结。
achievements.description_en: Help Hiromi resolve his angst.

achievements.title: 不再变老
achievements.description: 向殁者献上花束。
achievements.description_en: Pay your respects to the deceased.

achievements.title: 为人的条件？
achievements.description: 见证武士的宿命。
achievements.description_en: Witness the fate of the Samurai.

achievements.title: 无灵魂处的灵魂
achievements.description: 找到鹫津的遗物。
achievements.description_en: Find Washizu's lost possessions.

achievements.title: 荒岛朝圣指南
achievements.description: 找到八酝岛所有的神龛。
achievements.description_en: Find all the shrines on Yashiori Island.

achievements.title: 三千里的起点
achievements.description: 在踏鞴砂和鸣神岛找到长次。
achievements.description_en: Find Chouji on Tatarasuna and Narukami Island.

achievements.title: 游医的奥德赛
achievements.description: 见证保本的结局。
achievements.description_en: Find out what happened to Yasumoto.

achievements.title: 「Knock Knock」
achievements.description: 打开「御影炉心」周围的护罩。
achievements.description_en: Disable the containment dome surrounding the Mikage Furnace.

achievements.title: 神无冢作战计划
achievements.description: 打倒复苏的「无相之雷」。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the revived Electro Hypostasis.

achievements.title: 挥刀的理由
achievements.description: 让「公义」恢复清醒。
achievements.description_en: Help Masanori return to his senses.

achievements.title: 大业物
achievements.description: 挑战并轻松击败「公义」。
achievements.description_en: Defeat Masanori with ease.

achievements.title: 重开之花
achievements.description: 获得叶名山薰的赠礼。
achievements.description_en: Obtain Hanayama Kaoru's gift.

achievements.title: 承蒙惠顾
achievements.description: 获得阿敬的宝箱里的大奖。
achievements.description_en: Obtain the grand prize from Takashi's chests.

achievements.title: 雷之祸乱
achievements.description: 因为「雷祸」的伤害而倒下…
achievements.description_en: Get struck down by Balethunder...

achievements.title: 框架外收获
achievements.description: 用「神居岛崩炮」轰开一处藏宝地。
achievements.description_en: Use the Kamuijima Cannon to reveal a treasure trove.

achievements.title: 大踏鞴长正
achievements.description: 获得过去某把武器的绘图。
achievements.description_en: Obtain the diagram of a certain weapon from the past.

achievements.title: 「…腐肉朽处花争妍。」
achievements.description: 终结十位已殁武士的怨念。
achievements.description_en: End the wrath of 10 deceased samurai.

achievements.title: 「这就是我的放生路线！」
achievements.description: 鱼儿在挣扎状态中逃脱。
achievements.description_en: Allow a struggling fish to get off the hook.

achievements.title: 「切，原来是来钓鱼的…」
achievements.description: 抛竿时吓跑了鱼儿。
achievements.description_en: Scare the fish away when casting your rod.

achievements.title: 如愿以偿
achievements.description: 请小卷婆婆占卜五次，并获得理想的结果。
achievements.description_en: Have your fortune told 5 times by Granny Komaki while obtaining an ideal result.

achievements.title: 人鱼童话
achievements.description: 帮助久美解开心结。
achievements.description_en: Help Kumi with her problem.

achievements.title: 远海牧人的宝藏
achievements.description: 从酒醉的狂言中，寻到大海贼最宝贵的遗产。
achievements.description_en: Gain the most valued treasure of a great pirate from the ramblings of drunkards.

achievements.title: 诚实高个儿西尔弗
achievements.description: 找到林藏埋藏的所有宝藏。
achievements.description_en: Find all of Rinzou's buried treasure.

achievements.title: 是时候征服海祇岛了！
achievements.title_en: Today, This Seal — Tomorrow, Watatsumi Island!
achievements.description: 解除雷神神龛处的封印。
achievements.description_en: Break the seal over the Electro Archon's shrine.
achievements.series_master_title_en: Today, This Seal — Tomorrow, Watatsumi Island!

achievements.title: 池中宅邸
achievements.description: 解锁「池中宅邸」。
achievements.description_en: Unlock "Palace in a Pool"

achievements.title: 小猎犬号搁浅记
achievements.description: 跟随无名学者的脚步探索海祇岛。
achievements.description_en: Explore Watatsumi Island, following in the footsteps of an unknown researcher.

achievements.title: 「奴家是猫。名字叫寝子」
achievements.description: 拜见「浅濑神社代宫司」寝子。
achievements.description_en: Meet Neko, the "Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine."

achievements.title: 云中的猫
achievements.description: 和「浅濑神社代宫司」寝子一起，见证某件迟来的「好事」。
achievements.description_en: Witness a "good thing" come lately together with Neko, the "Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine."

achievements.title: 猫的赠礼
achievements.description: 在清籁岛上为小猫喂食，并获得它们的好感。
achievements.description_en: Feed the kittens on Seirai Island and gain their affection.

achievements.title: 无可质疑的宝藏
achievements.description: 「都说了只有一幅画啊！」
achievements.description_en: "I already told you, it's just a picture!"

achievements.title: 乡愁的另一头
achievements.title_en: On the Other Side of Homesickness
achievements.description: 为太田太郎在清籁岛上拍摄四张画片。
achievements.description_en: Help Oda Tarou take four pictures of Seirai Island.
achievements.series_master_title_en: On the Other Side of Homesickness

achievements.title: 它和它…
achievements.description: …连连看？
achievements.description_en: ... Try connecting them?

achievements.title: 戴维·琼斯的箱子
achievements.description: 解开「清籁丸」内的所有机关。
achievements.description_en: Unlock all the mechanisms onboard the "Seiraimaru."

achievements.title: 益智海域
achievements.description: 在清籁岛上解开一系列机关。
achievements.description_en: Unlock one series of mechanisms on Seirai Island

achievements.title: 大天云峠
achievements.description: 解开天云峠之底的机关。
achievements.description_en: Unlock the mechanism beneath Amakumo Peak

achievements.title: 进入夜雾之门
achievements.description: 适应了鹤观的异常天候。
achievements.description_en: Get used to Tsurumi Island's odd weather.

achievements.title: Nihil Sub Caligine Novum
achievements.description: 似乎又恢复了原状…
achievements.description_en: Seems like you're back to square one...

achievements.title: 白之幻影
achievements.description: 与昔日的幻影相遇。
achievements.description_en: Encounter the illusions of the ancient past

achievements.title: 「美好的风景，望不到头」
achievements.title_en: "Lovely Sights, Further Than the Eye Can See"
achievements.description: 与「船工」告别。
achievements.description_en: Bid farewell to your boatman.
achievements.series_master_title_en: "Lovely Sights, Further Than the Eye Can See"

achievements.title: 双城记
achievements.description: 即使是鹤观，似乎也建立在古老遗迹的残骸上。
achievements.description_en: Even Tsurumi Island seems to be built atop the wreckage of ancient ruins.

achievements.title: 《我作为冒险家的一生》
achievements.description: 协助罗尔德，完成冒险日志。
achievements.description_en: Help Roald to complete his adventure diary.

achievements.title: 雾里明灯
achievements.description: 点亮逢岳之野所有的雷石。
achievements.description_en: Light up all the Stormstones on the Autake Plains.

achievements.title: 「被、被派蒙吃掉…」
achievements.description: 原本拿到的「木簧笛」，却意外消失了。
achievements.description_en: Have the Maushiro that you got go missing.

achievements.title: 猜想时间
achievements.description: 从比过去更遥远的过去，来到了今天…
achievements.description_en: From an even more distant past to the present day...

achievements.title: 雷鸟的系谱
achievements.description: 完成所有「雕像」的挑战。
achievements.description_en: Complete all the statue challenges.

achievements.title: 七个字母
achievements.description: 尝试解读「石根文字」。
achievements.description_en: Try to decipher the Ishine Script.

achievements.title: 茂知之壳

achievements.description_en: Experience your first mirage in the desert.

achievements.title: 发掘报告怎么写？
achievements.title_en: How Do You Write the Excavation Report?
achievements.description: 第一次探索沙漠地下的遗迹。
achievements.description_en: Explore the ruins beneath the desert for the first time.
achievements.series_master_title_en: How Do You Write the Excavation Report?

achievements.title: 在风中飘荡
achievements.description: 击碎在沙漠中飘飞的风滚草。
achievements.description_en: Break the tumbleweed drifting in the desert.

achievements.title: 飞跃医院
achievements.title_en: One Flew Over the Sick Men's Rest
achievements.description: 曾有一位生还者逃离此处。
achievements.description_en: There was one survivor who got away.
achievements.series_master_title_en: One Flew Over the Sick Men's Rest

achievements.title: 训练有素的考古学家
achievements.description: 让列柱沙原 、上风蚀地、下风蚀地所有的元能尖碑重新运转。
achievements.description_en: Bring all the Primal Obelisks in the Hypostyle Desert, Land of Upper Setekh, and Land of Lower Setekh back to life.

achievements.title: 超越时间的虚影
achievements.description: 触碰沙漠中每一处神秘的壁画。
achievements.description_en: Touch every mysterious mural in the desert.

achievements.title: 「假若她们能知幽玄…」
achievements.description: 利露帕尔自行解脱了与你的契约，选择面对自己漆黑深远的命运…
achievements.description_en: Liloupar frees herself of her contract with you, choosing to face her dark and distant destiny...

achievements.title: 「那只是永恒的奴役而已！」
achievements.description: 沉睡千百年的镇灵利露帕尔与你订立了契约。
achievements.description_en: The Jinni Liloupar, who has slumbered for hundreds and thousands of years, enters into a pact with you.

achievements.title: 无名之城的过往
achievements.description: 居尔城神殿的壁画，讲述着一度辉煌的过往…
achievements.description_en: The murals within the temple of Gurabad speak of a glorious bygone age...

achievements.title: 宁静无梦的乐园
achievements.description: 此处是花神的陵寝，是神明无梦的长眠…
achievements.description_en: This is the mausoleum of the Goddess of Flowers. This is the long and dreamless slumber of a god...

achievements.title: 「…她必施行报应。」
achievements.description: 当复仇者施展义怒，施行不义之人何曾预见过这一天呢？
achievements.description_en: Will the evil-doers and their oracles have known of this day, when the avenger unleashes her righteous fury?

achievements.title: 被染红的月亮
achievements.description: 这片广阔的棋盘，曾在血红的月亮之下推演何种暴行？
achievements.description_en: Across this vast chessboard, what horrors have been enacted under the light of the blood-red moon?

achievements.title: 横冲直撞
achievements.description: 盲目的沙虫在沙面猪突猛进，偶尔也会带来意外收获。
achievements.description_en: The blind Wenut crash across the desert, and yet even such reckless charges do sometimes yield results...

achievements.title: 「我也讨厌沙虫！」
achievements.description: 第一次遭受沙虫的袭击。
achievements.description_en: Be attacked by a Wenut for the first time.

achievements.title: 分歧的原点
achievements.description: 知悉镀金旅团派往居尔城的调查队覆灭的真相。
achievements.description_en: Discover the truth behind the destruction of the Eremite investigative expedition to Gurabad.

achievements.title: 甚至不需要操作手册…
achievements.description: 让奔奔恢复以往的活力。
achievements.description_en: Revive Benben to its former state.

achievements.title: 猎人的仁慈
achievements.description: 让「猎鹰」塔德菈选择她的命运…
achievements.description_en: Let Tadhla the Falcon choose her own fate...

achievements.title: 飞毯之旅
achievements.description: 看看这整个新世界，多令人眩晕的地方！
achievements.description_en: This whole new world, this dazzling place I never knew!

achievements.title: 「生命，很神奇吧？」
achievements.description: 沙虫的行宫错综复杂，生命总能开辟出意想不到的通路…
achievements.description_en: The Wenut tunnel their palaces windingly, perhaps even intricately, since life always finds a way...

achievements.title: 旧日的园圃与源泉
achievements.description: 旧日澧泉不竭的阶池，如今已被黄沙填满…
achievements.description_en: The terraced pools that once overflowed with spring water have now been filled with yellow sand...

achievements.title: 她的黄金时代…
achievements.description: 紫红色的帕蒂莎兰盛开在空空的王座上，仿佛女主人永恒的笑容…
achievements.description_en: The fuchsia Padisarahs bloom upon an empty throne, like the eternal smile of their mistress...

achievements.title: 「…使列邦观看你的丑陋。」
achievements.description: 使残损的棋盘重现黄沙之间。
achievements.description_en: Make the damaged chessboard re-emerge amidst the sands.

achievements.title: 来自泥土，归于黄沙…
achievements.title_en: From Soil You Are, and to the Sand You Shall Return...
achievements.description: 正如沙漠中的一切生命那般…
achievements.description_en: Just like all who dwell in the desert...
achievements.series_master_title_en: From Soil You Are, and to the Sand You Shall Return...

achievements.title: 完美沙暴
achievements.description: 「让我们直冲气象地狱。」
achievements.description_en: "We're heading straight into meteorological hell."

achievements.title: 无爱的塔兰图拉
achievements.description: 「我非要把你煮成润滑油不可！」
achievements.description_en: "I swear I'm gonna boil you down for axle grease!"

achievements.title: 帕维兹拉万·赫瓦拉
achievements.description: 让千壑沙地所有的元能尖碑重新运转。
achievements.description_en: Bring all the Primal Obelisks in the Desert of Hadramaveth back to life.

achievements.title: 漫长的盟约
achievements.description: 尽管命运已各自破碎，盟约依旧在沉眠中存续…
achievements.description_en: Though destinies may be sundered, the pact lives on in slumber...

achievements.title: 光之大地
achievements.description: 抵达甘露花海。
achievements.description_en: Reach Vourukasha Oasis.

achievements.title: 从灰暗群山间升起
achievements.title_en: Like a Morning Sun Coming Out of Gloomy Mountains
achievements.description: 护送米希尔走完「净罪的巡礼路」。
achievements.description_en: Escort Mihir through her cleansing pilgrimage.
achievements.series_master_title_en: Like a Morning Sun Coming Out of Gloomy Mountains

achievements.title: 山上之树
achievements.description: 使拉沙鲁回归甘露花海。
achievements.description_en: Bring Rashnu back to the Vourukasha Oasis.

achievements.title: 浓雾之下
achievements.description: 驱散弥漫在锋刃林泽的紫色烟霭。
achievements.description_en: Dispel the purple mist permeating Asipattravana Swamp.

achievements.title: 就在这里敲吧
achievements.description: 回收全部五个「俱利般地」。
achievements.description_en: Retrieve all five Korybantes.

achievements.title: 群鸟的授记
achievements.description: 在祖尔宛的见证下，斯露莎已取得「双角的花冠」…
achievements.description_en: Sorush has obtained the Twin-Horned Chaplet with Zurvan as her witness...

achievements.title: 看我正义的一击！
achievements.description: 使用遗迹重炮击破巨像的核心。
achievements.description_en: Use the Ruin Cannon to destroy the Golem's core.

achievements.title: 「…将一切希望弃扬。」
achievements.title_en: "...Abandon All Hope, Ye Who Enter Here."
achievements.description: 到达地上国度的尽头。
achievements.description_en: Reach the end of the surface realms.
achievements.series_master_title_en: "...Abandon All Hope, Ye Who Enter Here."

achievements.title: 大铸造者
achievements.description: 启动地下遗迹工坊中的大升降机。
achievements.description_en: Activate the large elevator in the underground ruin workshop.

achievements.title: 七谷的试炼
achievements.description: 「灵光绝唱」的力量已在掌握之中。
achievements.description_en: You now wield the power of the Great Songs of Khvarena.

achievements.title: 横跨深渊的绳索
achievements.description: 完成离渡之仪，打开穿过黑渊的道路…
achievements.description_en: Complete the Rite of Chinvat and clear a path through the dark hollow.

achievements.title: 骆驼、狮子和孩子
achievements.title_en: The Camel, the Lion, and the Child
achievements.description: 从沾染污秽的「染境」中取得所有「慈心」。
achievements.description_en: Obtain all Spenta Hearts from the tarnished Defiled Chambers.
achievements.series_master_title_en: The Camel, the Lion, and the Child

achievements.title: 蒂尔甘之日
achievements.description: 洁净高天的渊薮后，灵光与甘露的力量已遍撒大地。
achievements.description_en: Upon cleansing the abyss of heaven above, the power of Khvarena and Amrita radiates across the land.

achievements.title: 奇景之旅
achievements.description: 完成「画家漂流记」。
achievements.description_en: Complete "An Artist Adrift."

achievements.title: 「谜题全都解开了！」
achievements.description: 完成「碑铭的研究」。
achievements.description_en: Complete "Monumental Study."

achievements.title: 百灵归巢
achievements.description: 完成「微暗之火」。
achievements.description_en: Complete "Pale Fire."

achievements.title: 丰饶之海
achievements.description: 花海中的所有花池都恢复了生机。
achievements.description_en: All the ponds in the Vourukasha Oasis are now revitalized.

achievements.title: 勇者不会逃避
achievements.description: 通过贾尔贾设下的全部试炼。
achievements.description_en: Pass all the trials set by Jarjar.

achievements.title: 闪光的道路
achievements.description: 完成所有「灵宝铎」的挑战。
achievements.description_en: Complete all the "Soul Bell" challenges.

achievements.title: 历七盘而蹝蹑
achievements.description: 完成所有「奇鼓跳跳菇」的挑战。
achievements.description_en: Complete all "Percussive Prancing Mushroom" challenges.

achievements.title: 黑泥流中的光辉
achievements.description: 第一次利用灵光的力量，清除灰余晶。
achievements.description_en: Use the power of Khvarena to destroy the Gray Crystals for the first time.

achievements.title: 当红帕化作飞鸟…
achievements.title_en: When the Red Scarf Transforms Into a Bird in Flight...
achievements.description: 第一次使用斯露莎飞行。
achievements.description_en: Make your first flight with Sorush.
achievements.series_master_title_en: When the Red Scarf Transforms Into a Bird in Flight...

achievements.title: 在萨雷-奥杰卡的天空翱翔
achievements.title_en: Soaring in the Skies of Sary-Ozek
achievements.description: 使斯露莎维持飞行一段时间。
achievements.description_en: Keep Sorush in flight for a while.
achievements.series_master_title: 在萨雷-奥杰卡的天空翱翔
achievements.series_master_title_en: Soaring in the Skies of Sary-Ozek

achievements.title: 你是谁的子孙，叫什么名字？
achievements.title_en: Whose Descendant Are You, and What's Your Name?
achievements.description: 第一次使用斯露莎引导灵光之力。
achievements.description_en: Call upon the power of Khvarena with Sorush for the first time.
achievements.series_master_title: 你是谁的子孙，叫什么名字？
achievements.series_master_title_en: Whose Descendant Are You, and What's Your Name?

achievements.title: 要用原力，斯露莎
achievements.description: 使用斯露莎投掷「苦离果」，融化15个甘露凝结的晶石。
achievements.description_en: Launch Nirodha Fruits with Sorush's help to melt 15 crystals condensed from Amrita.

achievements.title: 抹消角度的人
achievements.description: 借助结晶体的力量，压制兽境裂隙。
achievements.description_en: Suppress the Beastly Rift using the power of the crystals.

achievements.title: 炉心冷却
achievements.description: 让翻腾的湖面重归平静。
achievements.description_en: Cause the roiling lake to become placid once more.

achievements.title: 白船
achievements.description: 「她在梦海之上遨游…」
achievements.description_en: "She's sailing on the sea of dreams..."

achievements.title: 真是让人垂涎欲滴
achievements.description: 帮助恩里改变命运。
achievements.description_en: Help Henri change his fate.

achievements.title: 自然哲学百科全书
achievements.description: 靠一面玻璃幕墙和一本无法解读的书发现了过去的结社集会所。
achievements.description_en: Use the glass wall and an indecipherable book to discover the gathering place of an old society.

achievements.title: 枫丹式的消息
achievements.description: 和维吉尔友好地聊了聊。
achievements.description_en: Have a friendly chat with Virgil.

achievements.title: 不过是条猎犬…
achievements.description: 帮助玛梅赫修好了西摩尔。
achievements.description_en: Help Mamere fix Seymour.

achievements.title: 是鱼肉，我加了鱼肉
achievements.description: 与美露莘们一起品尝了奇妙的「生日蛋糕」。
achievements.description_en: Taste the wonderful "birthday cake" with the Melusine.

achievements.title: 欢迎来到枫丹
achievements.description: 完成一次巡轨船的航行。
achievements.description_en: Complete a cruise on the aquabus.

achievements.title: 飞行的梦想
achievements.description: 完成一次「安东·罗杰飞行器」的航程。
achievements.description_en: Complete a flight with the Antoine Roger Aircraft.

achievements.title: 现代钟表的诞生
achievements.description: 帮助芙佳找到矿石的「用处」。
achievements.description_en: Help Puca find a way to "use" the ore.

achievements.title: 未来水世界
achievements.description: 见到「水面」之下的「水体」。
achievements.description_en: Gaze upon the "water" beneath the "surface."

achievements.title: 丑的美学
achievements.description: 枫丹朝美的方向前进了两步。
achievements.description_en: And thus does Fontaine take two steps further toward beauty.

achievements.title: 就像雨中的泪水
achievements.description: 揪出隐藏在猎刀鳐中的伪装者。
achievements.description_en: Find the impostor amidst the Hunter's Rays.

achievements.title: 圆滚滚的创化论
achievements.description: 陪伴幼小的膨膨兽健康长大。
achievements.description_en: Accompany the small Blubberbeast as it grows big and strong.

achievements.title: 这是我喜爱的事物中…
achievements.title_en: These Are a Few of My...
achievements.description: …小小的一部分。
achievements.description_en: ...Favorite Things.
achievements.series_master_title_en: These Are a Few of My...

achievements.title: 还施彼身
achievements.description: 解决很烦人的子弹藤壶！
achievements.description_en: Take care of those annoying Bullet Barnacles!

achievements.title: 你是否相信极乐城？
achievements.description: 帮助缔造膨膨兽的乐园。
achievements.description_en: Help build a Blubberbeast paradise.

achievements.title: 历经艰险…
achievements.description: 「…为了取得击败魔王的圣剑，骑士闯入了魔法封印的古城…」
achievements.description_en: "To obtain the holy blade that might defeat the demon king, the knight broke into the ancient city, sealed using magic..."

achievements.title: 从此以后…
achievements.description: 「…骑士战胜了魔王，救出了被囚禁的公主。王国终于恢复了光明…」
achievements.description_en: "The knight defeated the demon king, saving the imprisoned princess. Light has returned to the kingdom..."

achievements.title: 黑字的研究
achievements.description: 发现了自然哲学学院研究的…比较特别的对象。
achievements.description_en: Find a more... special subject of the Institute of Natural Philosophy's study.

achievements.title: 两万里格的漫游
achievements.title_en: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea
achievements.description: 随波逐流…
achievements.description_en: Go with the flow...
achievements.series_master_title_en: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea

achievements.title: 旧日之歌
achievements.description: 聆听来自悠远年代的伟大乐章。
achievements.description_en: Hear now the melody of ancient eons.

achievements.title: 「湖畔的尼尼安涅」
achievements.description: 战胜地方传奇·湖畔的尼尼安涅。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the local legend, Ninianne of the Lake.

achievements.title: 「湖畔的维维安涅」
achievements.description: 战胜地方传奇·湖畔的维维安涅。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the local legend, Vivianne of the Lake.

achievements.title: 恪尽其责的企盼
achievements.title_en: Fontaine Expects That Everyone Will Do Their Duty
achievements.description: 物归原主…
achievements.description_en: An item, returned to its rightful owner...
achievements.series_master_title_en: Fontaine Expects That Everyone Will Do Their Duty

achievements.title: 追忆泉华的时光
achievements.description: 枫丹的声望等级达到10级。
achievements.description_en: Reach Reputation Lv. 10 in Fontaine.

achievements.title: 「海原巡回法官」
achievements.description: 战胜地方传奇·海原巡回法官。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the local legend, Ocean Circuit Judge.

achievements.title: 「铁皮子爵」
achievements.description: 战胜地方传奇·铁皮子爵。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the local legend, Iron Viscount.

achievements.title: 「隐者王·多尔库」
achievements.description: 战胜地方传奇·隐者王·多尔库。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the local legend, Dobharcu, Lord of the Hidden.

achievements.title: 「渐渐隐去的老兵」
achievements.description: 战胜地方传奇「渐渐隐去的老兵」。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the local legend, Fading Veteran.

achievements.title: 「深谷之剑」
achievements.description: 战胜地方传奇·深谷之剑。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the local legends, the Swords of the Gorge.

achievements.title: 「双生妖精骑士」
achievements.description: 战胜地方传奇·双生妖精骑士。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the local legends, the Fairy Knight Twins.

achievements.title: 消费社会
achievements.description: 在「破烂骨头商店」尽情消费。
achievements.description_en: Buy as much as you like at the Rag and Bone Shop.

achievements.title: 当午夜钟声敲响
achievements.description: 知晓了卡特皮拉的真实面目。
achievements.description_en: Discover Caterpillar's true identity.

achievements.title: 非零和博弈
achievements.description: 完成了特许食堂内部满意度调研。
achievements.description_en: Complete the Coupon Cafeteria satisfaction survey.

achievements.title: 零余者的自述
achievements.description: 听克兰茨讲述了一些往事。
achievements.description_en: Listen to Clynes's story.

achievements.title: 四水果击
achievements.description: 完成了「秩序水果团」与布兰奇的故事。
achievements.description_en: Complete the "Fruity Order" and Blanche's story.

achievements.title: 彩虹的脚下是…？
achievements.title_en: What Lies at the End of the Rainbow...?
achievements.description: 循着光线的引导抵达了终点。
achievements.description_en: Follow the light to where it ultimately leads.
achievements.series_master_title_en: What Lies at the End of the Rainbow...?

achievements.title: 出来吧神秘矿！
achievements.title_en: Come on out, Mystery Ore! Grant my wish!
achievements.description: 集齐了七块神秘的黄绿色矿石。
achievements.description_en: Gather all seven mysterious yellow-green ores.
achievements.series_master_title_en: Come on out, Mystery Ore! Grant my wish!

achievements.title: 并不怎么窄的门
achievements.title_en: Not So Strait Is the Gate
achievements.description: 开启了通往某间藏书室的大门。
achievements.description_en: Opened the door to a certain secret study.
achievements.series_master_title_en: Not So Strait Is the Gate

achievements.title: 长日留痕
achievements.description: 花费了许多时间培育审美。
achievements.description_en: Spent a lot of time cultivating aesthetics.

achievements.title: 在未来多于过去的年岁
achievements.title_en: The Calendar of the Future Is Longer Than the Diary of the Past
achievements.description: 我们都有光明的未来…
achievements.description_en: We all have a bright future ahead of us...
achievements.series_master_title: 在未来多于过去的年岁
achievements.series_master_title_en: The Calendar of the Future Is Longer Than the Diary of the Past

achievements.title: 打破时间墙
achievements.description: 击破棘球孢囊，使该水域得到净化。
achievements.description_en: Pop the Thorny Cyst and purify the waters.

achievements.title: 被遗忘的纸带
achievements.description: 帮助布罗意回收并整理全部的「水文观测数据」。

achievements.title: 棱镜计划
achievements.description: 在无相之雷复苏前，摧毁所有复苏棱镜。
achievements.description_en: Break all of an Electro Hypostasis' Revival Prisms before it can be revived.

achievements.title: 「这风晶蝶还蛮大的」
achievements.description: 在无相之风复苏前，吸收所有风之晶球。
achievements.description_en: Absorb all of an Anemo Hypostasis' Wind Crystals before it can be revived.

achievements.title: 「…不代表最终品质」
achievements.description: 击败一个进行了四种元素转变的无相之风。
achievements.description_en: Defeat an Anemo Hypostasis that has undergone 4 types of Elemental Conversions.

achievements.title: …与巨像
achievements.description: 通过攻击要害，瘫痪遗迹守卫。
achievements.description_en: Paralyze a Ruin Guard by attacking its weak point.

achievements.title: 传球
achievements.description: 打落爆弹丘丘人手中的火史莱姆。
achievements.description_en: Knock a Pyro Slime out of the hands of a Hilichurl Grenadier.

achievements.title: 「一次…的攻击」
achievements.description: 通过碎冰伤害，打败一名敌人。
achievements.description_en: Defeat an opponent by Shattering the ice they are trapped in.

achievements.title: 大黄金丘丘王
achievements.description: 在魔化状态结束前，击败丘丘岩盔王。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Stonehide Lawachurl before its Infused Form can expire.

achievements.title: 向无敌大胃王致敬
achievements.description: 队伍中有四名角色同时处于饱腹状态。
achievements.description_en: Have 4 party members in the Full state at the same time.

achievements.title: 摧枯拉朽
achievements.description: 造成超过5000的暴击伤害。
achievements.description_en: Deal over 5,000 CRIT DMG.

achievements.title: 摧枯拉朽
achievements.description: 造成超过20000的暴击伤害。
achievements.description_en: Deal over 20,000 CRIT DMG.

achievements.title: 摧枯拉朽
achievements.description: 造成超过50000的暴击伤害。
achievements.description_en: Deal over 50,000 CRIT DMG.

achievements.title: 神奇四…
achievements.description: 使用四个相同元素属性的角色完成一次秘境挑战。
achievements.description_en: Complete a Domain using 4 characters of the same Elemental Type.

achievements.title: 「什么嘛，还不如冰雾花」
achievements.description: 不击破花冠弱点的情况下，击败急冻树。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Cryo Regisvine without destroying its corolla weak point.

achievements.title: 「总有比火更灼热的火」
achievements.description: 不击破花冠弱点的情况下，击败爆炎树。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Pyro Regisvine without destroying its corolla weak point.

achievements.title: 异邦人与异邦人
achievements.description: 队伍中所有角色都不被「公子」标记的后续攻击命中的情况下，击败「公子」。
achievements.description_en: Defeat Childe without any party member being marked and then hit by his follow-up attack.

achievements.title: 罚球
achievements.description: 有的地方是没办法挖出火史莱姆的…
achievements.description_en: There are places where one cannot simply dig Pyro Slimes out of the ground...

achievements.title: 力场侵蚀
achievements.description: 粉碎无相之雷的结界。
achievements.description_en: Destroy the Electro Hypostasis' barrier.

achievements.title: 「…还有蜥蜴和斯波克」
achievements.description: 同一个角色连续被猜拳三连击命中。
achievements.description_en: Have one character get hit by all three parts of the rock-paper-scissors attack consecutively.

achievements.title: 基础不牢，地动山摇！
achievements.description: 通过击碎核心停留的玄岩柱，使同一个无相之岩落地三次。
achievements.description_en: Cause the same Geo Hypostasis to fall three times by destroying the Basalt Column that it is on.

achievements.title: 基础再牢，也能撂倒！
achievements.description: 在不击碎玄岩柱的情况下，使无相之岩进入复苏模式。
achievements.description_en: Force the Geo Hypostasis into its revival state without destroying any Basalt Columns.

achievements.title: 千风散尽还复来
achievements.description: 在一场战斗中，吸收至少10个无相之风创造的元素晶球。
achievements.description_en: Absorb at least 10 Elemental Orbs created by the Anemo Hypostasis in a single battle.

achievements.title: 珠心熔毁
achievements.description: 摧毁爆炎树创造的炽热之种。
achievements.description_en: Destroy the Blazing Seed created by a Pyro Regisvine.

achievements.title: 眩晕
achievements.description: 在急冻树旋转喷发急冻射线时，击破其花冠弱点。
achievements.description_en: Destroy a Cryo Regisvine's corolla weak point while it is performing its rotary spray attack.

achievements.title: 「…唯独死亡与债务不可避」
achievements.description: 击败处于隐蔽状态下的火之债务处理人。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Fatui Agent while they are in their stealth mode.

achievements.title: 「孤独地融化…」
achievements.description: 在冰萤术士操控的冰萤全部存在的情况下，击败冰萤术士。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Cryo Cicin Mage while all her Cryo Cicins are currently active.

achievements.title: 这也算四风守护？
achievements.title_en: And You Call Yourself One of the Four Winds
achievements.description: 触发过风拳先锋军所有元素类型的吸收反击后，击败他。
achievements.description_en: Defeat an Anemoboxer Vanguard after having triggered all of their Elemental Absorptions.
achievements.series_master_title_en: And You Call Yourself One of the Four Winds

achievements.title: 碰·一·碰
achievements.description: 利用护盾反制岩龙蜥的某一式冲撞攻击。
achievements.description_en: Use a shield to counter a Geovishap's charging attack.

achievements.title: 反弹！
achievements.description: 利用护盾，反制古岩龙蜥的「原岩喷吐」攻击。
achievements.description_en: Use a shield to counter a Primo Geovishap's Primordial Shower attack.

achievements.title: 悉数奉还！
achievements.description: 利用同种元素类型或岩元素的护盾，反制古岩龙蜥的「原岩喷吐」攻击，并造成大量伤害。
achievements.description_en: Use a shield of a matching type (or a Geo shield) to counter a Geovishap's Primordial Shower attack and deal immense DMG.

achievements.title: 我们之中最坚强的灵魂
achievements.description: 击败所有形态的若陀龙王。
achievements.description_en: Defeat Azhdaha in all its forms.
achievements.series_master_title: 我们之中最坚强的灵魂

achievements.title: 「…一日之寒」
achievements.description: 击败处于虚弱状态的无相之冰。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Cryo Hypostasis that is in a weakened state.

achievements.title: 「冰冻三尺…」
achievements.description: 击败一个复苏了三次的无相之冰。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Cryo Hypostasis that has revived three times.

achievements.title: 只要我跑得够快
achievements.description: 不被幻影击中的情况下，击败魔偶剑鬼。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Maguu Kenki without being hit by its phantom's attacks.

achievements.title: 堂堂正正的决斗！
achievements.title_en: In This Solemn Matter Let No One Interfere!
achievements.description: 不触发「枉死之面」的格挡的情况下，击败魔偶剑鬼。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Maguu Kenki without triggering its "Oushi no Omote" parry.
achievements.series_master_title_en: In This Solemn Matter Let No One Interfere!

achievements.title: …全靠我们自己
achievements.description: 不触发「原岩喷吐」的反噬的情况下，击败古岩龙蜥。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Primo Geovishap without reflecting its Primordial Shower.

achievements.title: 把自己烧着了吧？
achievements.description: 击败一个复燃过两次的无相之火。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Pyro Hypostasis that has reignited twice.

achievements.title: Smells like Animal Spirit!
achievements.description: 被无相之火的拟态三连击命中后，击败它。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Pyro Hypostasis after being hit by its mimetic 3-hit combo.

achievements.title: 机元突破
achievements.description: 在一场战斗中，使恒常机关阵列的所有四种遗迹机兵均进入瘫痪状态，并击败恒常机关阵列。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Perpetual Mechanical Array after paralyzing all 4 types of its Ruin Sentinels.

achievements.title: 无关机械请立即离场！
achievements.title_en: Could All Uninvolved Machinery Please Leave Immediately?
achievements.description: 不击败任何恒常机关阵列的遗迹机兵的情况下，击败恒常机关阵列。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the Perpetual Mechanical Array without defeating any of its Ruin Sentinels.
achievements.series_master_title_en: Could All Uninvolved Machinery Please Leave Immediately?

achievements.title: 遇火斩火
achievements.description: 在海乱鬼·炎威的武器附有烈焰的情况下，击败海乱鬼·炎威。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Kairagi: Fiery Might while their weapon is infused with Pyro.

achievements.title: 遇雷切雷
achievements.description: 在海乱鬼·雷腾的武器附有电流的情况下，击败海乱鬼·雷腾。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Kairagi: Dancing Thunder while their weapon is infused with Electro.

achievements.title: 雷自东来
achievements.description: 被雷斧丘丘暴徒引来的落雷击中…
achievements.description_en: Be struck by the lightning called down by a Crackling Axe Mitachurl...

achievements.title: A Kill without Water
achievements.description: 不击败任何「水滴」的情况下（无相之水恢复时除外），击败无相之水。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the Hydro Hypostasis without destroying a single one of its Water Droplets (except when it is restoring HP.)

achievements.title: 海洋生物学者，欧拉！
achievements.description: 被无相之水幻化的某种生物击中…
achievements.description_en: Be hit by a certain animal created by the Hydro Hypostasis...

achievements.title: 无法传达的恋波
achievements.description: 不曾被探针的侦测锁定的情况下，击败雷音权现。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Thunder Manifestation without ever being locked onto.

achievements.title: 雷音坠落
achievements.description: 击败飞翔的雷音权现。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Thunder Manifestation while it is in flight.

achievements.title: 红莲冰河与红莲魔女
achievements.description: 在不破坏任何「炎之心」与「霜之眼」的情况下，击败「女士」。
achievements.description_en: Defeat Signora without destroying either her Hearts of Flame or Eyes of Frost.

achievements.title: 犬神家的末路
achievements.description: 短时间内击破两个「兽境犬首」。
achievements.description_en: Destroy two Rifthound Skulls within a short time.

achievements.title: 硬着陆
achievements.description: 将攀援中的深海龙蜥击落。
achievements.description_en: Bring a climbing Bathysmal Vishap down.

achievements.title: 正法眼藏
achievements.description: 仅仅击落真正的对手…
achievements.description_en: Only shoot down your real opponent...

achievements.title: 猛犬注意
achievements.description: 击败正在咆哮的兽境猎犬。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a roaring Rifthound.

achievements.title: 基本上无害
achievements.description: 击败没有积攒任何怒气的飘浮灵。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Specter that has not accumulated any Fury.

achievements.title: 光之流溢
achievements.description: 在遗迹巨蛇的挑战中，利用一次「纯光绽放」破坏二个「淤泥涌口」。
achievements.description_en: Destroy 2 Oozing Concretions with 1 Blooming Light during a battle against the Ruin Serpent.

achievements.title: 「汉总是先开枪…」
achievements.description: …所以不要带着刀进入枪战。
achievements.description_en: ...So don't bring a knife to a gunfight.

achievements.title: 渔人之利
achievements.description: 见证了蕈兽间的友军伤害。
achievements.description_en: Watch the infighting between the Fungi.

achievements.title: 「给我下来！」
achievements.description: 击落飞行中的有翼蕈兽。
achievements.description_en: Shoot down a flying Fungus.

achievements.title: 金风玉露一相逢
achievements.description: 放任掣电树释放的电荷相撞。
achievements.description_en: Let the Electro Regisvine perform its charged electrical collision.

achievements.title: …三而竭？
achievements.description: 见识过活化状态下的翠翎恐蕈的三种强力技能。
achievements.description_en: Witness the three powerful abilities used by the activated Jadeplume Terrorshroom.

achievements.title: 遗迹先生，别再冲了——！
achievements.description: 通过攻击头部的核心，中断兆载永劫龙兽的冲锋攻击。
achievements.description_en: Interrupt the charged attack of the Aeonblight Drake by attacking the core on its head.

achievements.title: 那诺曼辛，孩子！
achievements.description: 击败处于活化状态下正在施展强力技能的翠翎恐蕈…
achievements.description_en: Defeat an activated Jadeplume Terrorshroom while it is unleashing a powerful skill...

achievements.title: 展开攻性防壁
achievements.description: 见识过半永恒统辖矩阵的超频冲击…
achievements.description_en: Witness the overclocking impact of the Algorithm of Semi-Intransient Matrix of Overseer Network.

achievements.title: 看不见的手
achievements.description: 在不破除元能构装体的不可视状态的情况下将其击败。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the Primal Construct without disabling its invisible state.

achievements.title: 神奇的固氮作用
achievements.title_en: The Marvelous Uses of Nitrogen Fixation
achievements.description: 在一次无相之草挑战中，使三枚愈疗草芯同时处于活化状态。
achievements.description_en: During one Dendro Hypostasis challenge, cause three Restorative Piths to be in an Activated state simultaneously.
achievements.series_master_title_en: The Marvelous Uses of Nitrogen Fixation

achievements.title: 落草之谈
achievements.description: 在无相之草进行下落攻击时，烧毁它的藤蔓外壳。
achievements.description_en: Burn the Dendro Hypostasis' vine shell as it is performing a Plunging Attack.

achievements.title: 落落磊磊
achievements.description: 利用元素矩阵，使正机之神过载瘫痪。
achievements.description_en: Use the Elemental Matrices to overload and paralyze Shouki no Kami.

achievements.title: 生灭去来
achievements.description: 刹那生灭中，一切皆有正机…
achievements.description_en: Even at the edge of obliteration, a comeback is still on the cards...

achievements.title: 控制了香料的人…
achievements.description: 通过使风蚀弹发生扩散反应，击落浮游状态的风蚀沙虫。
achievements.description_en: Use the Windbite Bullets to perform Swirl reactions and bring the Setekh Wenut in its floating form down.

achievements.title: 此时无声胜有声
achievements.title_en: When You Say Nothing at All
achievements.description: 在深罪浸礼者进行初始之吟唱时，通过摧毁其所有的元素之环，使之瘫痪。
achievements.description_en: Destroy all Elemental Rings to paralyze the Iniquitous Baptist when it begins to channel its attack.
achievements.series_master_title_en: When You Say Nothing at All

achievements.title: 二河白道之卷
achievements.title_en: The White Path Between Two Rivers
achievements.description: 惜败于与传奇猎刀鳐的决斗中…
achievements.description_en: Lose in the duel against the legendary Hunter's Ray...
achievements.series_master_title_en: The White Path Between Two Rivers

achievements.title: 单元格碎片
achievements.description: 通过荒性或芒性的攻击，中断隙境原体的应激状态。
achievements.description_en: Use Pneuma or Ousia attacks to interrupt the Breacher Primus's stress state.

achievements.title: 热腾腾！
achievements.description: 不断尝试冰冻浊水幻灵…
achievements.description_en: Constantly attempt to freeze Tainted Hydro Phantasms...

achievements.title: 送葬的风暴
achievements.description: 通过芒性的攻击，削弱歌裴莉娅演出高潮时的旋风。
achievements.description_en: Use a Pneuma attack to weaken the whirlwind Coppelia creates during the performance's climax.

achievements.title: 坚冰的赌咒
achievements.description: 通过荒性的攻击，移除科培琉司演出高潮时的护罩。
achievements.description_en: Use an Ousia attack to remove the Ward that Coppelius deploys during the performance's climax.

achievements.title: 吾王崩御，吾王万岁！
achievements.title_en: The King Is Dead, Long Live the King!
achievements.description: 中断铁甲熔火帝皇的「烈焰加冕」。
achievements.description_en: Interrupt the Emperor of Fire and Iron's Searing Coronation.
achievements.series_master_title_en: The King Is Dead, Long Live the King!

achievements.title: 我们是万众一体
achievements.description: 在一次挑战中，两次阻止水形幻人吸收半幻人。
achievements.description_en: Stop the Hydro Tulpa from absorbing Half-Tulpas twice in one challenge.

achievements.title: 银河搭便车指南
achievements.title_en: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
achievements.description: 在一次挑战中，两次进入巨鲸之腹。
achievements.description_en: Enter the belly of the beast twice during a single challenge.
achievements.series_master_title_en: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

achievements.title: 冰与风的鼓动
achievements.title_en: A Pulse of Ice and Wind
achievements.description: 探寻隐山猊兽与冰元素之间的关系。
achievements.description_en: Search for the connection between Solitary Suanni and Cryo.
achievements.series_master_title_en: A Pulse of Ice and Wind

achievements.title: 「我警惕雷穆利亚人…」
achievements.description: 「…即使他们带着乐器。」
achievements.description_en: "...Even should they carry instruments."

achievements.title: 同样的错误
achievements.description: 「远程作战对我们有利…咦？」
achievements.description_en: "Ranged combat is advantageous to us... Huh!?"

achievements.title: 盛宴之后
achievements.description: 在厄月的见证下，渡越血色的盛宴。
achievements.description_en: Reach the other side of the blood-red banquet, with the baleful moon as your witness.

achievements.title: 猎龙的黑箭…
achievements.description: 击破「金焰」形态下金焰绒翼龙暴君的火元素护罩，使其从空中坠落。
achievements.description_en: Destroy the Goldflame Qucusaur Tyrant's Pyro Ward while it is in the "Goldflame" state to make it fall out of the sky

achievements.title: 你也是迪诺巴鲁托？
achievements.description: 在贪食匿叶龙山王吞下火榴果之前将其点燃，使果子在被吞下后爆炸。
achievements.description_en: Ignite the Flamegranate before the Gluttonous Yumkasaur Mountain King swallows it, causing the fruit to explode after being swallowed.

achievements.title: 月亮还没有出来
achievements.description: 在秘源机兵·构型械准备「球状雷炮」时，破坏「汲聚械」打断它的蓄能。
achievements.description_en: While the Secret Source Automaton: Configuration Device is charging its "Boltsphere Cannon," break the "Accretion Mechanism" and interrupt the process.

achievements.title: 元素穿甲弹
achievements.description: 破除一次深邃摹结株的虚界力护罩。
achievements.description_en: Break a Tenebrous Papilla's Void Ward once.

achievements.title: 按下自爆按钮！
achievements.description: 通过持续的火元素攻击，使熔岩辉龙像熔化崩解。
achievements.description_en: Cause the Lava Dragon Statue to disintegrate using continuous Pyro attacks.

achievements.title: 当那突角龙杀到
achievements.description: 利用突角龙或「沃陆之邦」的部族成员的冲刺，中断炉壳山鼬的冲撞。
achievements.description_en: Use a Tatankasaurus or a Collective of Plenty character's sprint to interrupt the Furnace Shell Mountain Weasel's charge.

achievements.title: 「深蓝」
achievements.description: 解开弈局中的所有谜题。
achievements.description_en: Solve all the puzzles in the chess game.

achievements.title: 液流冰结
achievements.description: 连续使用冰元素进行攻击，阻碍「液流动量」的积累。
achievements.description_en: Use consecutive Cryo attacks to impede the accumulation of Flow Momentum.

achievements.title: 武库巨鸭的坠落
achievements.description: 通过击坠所有冲鸭机关，破除重拳出击鸭的护罩。
achievements.description_en: Destroy Knuckle Duckle's Ward by downing all of its Stamping Devices.

achievements.title: 蕴光之茧
achievements.description: 为角色恢复生命值，清除「蕴光之茧」。
achievements.description_en: Heal your characters and remove the Radiant Cocoon.

achievements.title: 无声指令
achievements.description: 中断了敌方的进程。
achievements.description_en: Interrupt the enemy's progress.

achievements.description: 在战斗中不曾获取过护盾的情况下，击败若陀龙王。
achievements.description_en: Defeat Azhdaha without ever having gained a shield.

achievements.title: 将盐送给敌人，将水留给自己
achievements.title_en: Salt for My Foes, and Water for Me
achievements.description: 在一次无相之水挑战中，获取至少三个「水滴」发射的愈疗晶球。
achievements.description_en: Obtain at least three healing orbs fired from the "water droplets" during the Hydro Hypostasis fight.
achievements.series_master_title: 将盐送给敌人，将水留给自己
achievements.series_master_title_en: Salt for My Foes, and Water for Me

achievements.title: 碍于归途艰险…
achievements.description: 利用障碍物、击飞等方式，在不破坏「水滴」的情况下，阻止无相之水复苏。
achievements.description_en: Stop the Hydro Hypostasis from reviving itself without destroying any of the "water droplets" by placing obstacles or repelling them.

achievements.title: 破灭之时
achievements.description: 在不利用「红莲蛾」的情况下，击败「女士」 。
achievements.description_en: Defeat Signora without using any Crimson Lotus Moths.

achievements.title: 逃逸电子
achievements.description: 在不被追踪电笼击中的情况下，击败雷音权现。
achievements.description_en: Defeat a Thunder Manifestation without being hit by its homing thunder cage attack.

achievements.title: 无线电静默
achievements.description: 在攻击雷音权现之前，被它的侦测锁定。
achievements.description_en: Get locked on by the Thunder Manifestation before you can attack it.

achievements.title: 禁止游泳
achievements.description: 在深海龙蜥之群挑战中，在深海龙蜥未入水的情况下击败它们。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the Bathysmal Vishap Herd without allowing them to dive into the water.

achievements.title: 不坏之金刚
achievements.description: 在一次祸津御建鸣神命挑战中，躲过恶曜三钴在一轮中释放的所有金刚坏灭波。
achievements.description_en: Dodge one entire round of the Baleful Vajra's destructive waves during one battle with Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Mikoto.

achievements.title: 自噬之蛇
achievements.description: 在遗迹巨蛇汲取能量时，通过破坏「淤泥涌口」，使其瘫痪。
achievements.description_en: Destroy Oozing Concretions to paralyze the Ruin Serpent while it is gathering energy.

achievements.title: 末路狂花
achievements.title_en: The Mad Flower at the End of the Road
achievements.description: 掣电树放射集束电光时，通过攻击其花冠，使之瘫痪。
achievements.description_en: When the Electro Regisvine emits a beam of thunderous light, paralyze it by attacking its corolla.
achievements.series_master_title_en: The Mad Flower at the End of the Road

achievements.title: 彼竭我盈故克之
achievements.description: 击败活化状态结束后，正处于力竭状态下的翠翎恐蕈。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the exhausted Jadeplume Terrorshroom after its Activated state is finished.

achievements.title: 清晨的焦枯蕈兽的气味
achievements.title_en: The Smell of Grilled Mushrooms in the Morning
achievements.description: 一次挑战中，击败6个翠翎恐蕈因陷入燃烧状态而产生的蕈兽。
achievements.description_en: In a single challenge, defeat 6 Fungi produced by Jadeplume Terrorshroom in a Burning state.
achievements.series_master_title: 清晨的焦枯蕈兽的气味
achievements.series_master_title_en: The Smell of Grilled Mushrooms in the Morning

achievements.title: 龙兽射落之日
achievements.description: 一次挑战中，通过攻击双翼上的核心，使兆载永劫龙兽坠落。
achievements.description_en: In a single challenge, bring the Aeonblight Drake down by attacking the cores on its wings.

achievements.title: 头盖骨胜负
achievements.description: 一次挑战中，通过攻击头部的核心，中断兆载永劫龙兽的能量洪流。
achievements.description_en: In a single challenge, interrupt the energy flow of the Aeonblight Drake by attacking the core on its head.

achievements.title: 抗性，有用吗？
achievements.description: 击败提升过至少两种不同元素抗性的兆载永劫龙兽。
achievements.description_en: Defeat an Aeonblight Drake that has increased resistance to at least two different elements.

achievements.title: 电子脑硬化症
achievements.description: 击败处于超频过载状态下的半永恒统辖矩阵。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the Algorithm of Semi-Intransient Matrix of Overseer Network in its overclocked, Overloaded state.

achievements.title: 黛西，黛西
achievements.description: 通过原激化、超激化或蔓激化反应命中半永恒统辖矩阵核心，破除其不可视状态。
achievements.description_en: Break the Algorithm of Semi-Intransient Matrix of Overseer Network by hitting its cores with the Quicken, Aggravate, or Spread reactions.

achievements.title: 「拒绝的刺」
achievements.description: 通过火元素，烧毁无相之草在一次荆棘之环攻击中创造的所有荆棘。
achievements.description_en: Use Pyro to burn all the thorns created by the Dendro Hypostasis during its Ring of Thorns attack.

achievements.title: 食髓知味

achievements.description_en: Use the power of the Phagocytic Energy Blocks to immobilize the following enemies: Consecrated Red Vulture, Consecrated Scorpion, Consecrated Flying Serpent, Consecrated Horned Crocodile, and Consecrated Fanged Beast.

achievements.description: 在一次正机之神挑战中，激活所有的元素矩阵。
achievements.description_en: Activate all Elemental Matrices in a fight against Shouki no Kami, the Prodigal.

achievements.title: …攻彼之盾
achievements.description: 在正机之神进行藏界百摄爆轰时，摧毁其护罩。
achievements.description_en: Destroy Shouki no Kami's Ward while he is delivering a powerful barrage of attacks.

achievements.title: 这才叫四风守护！
achievements.title_en: Now That's What You Call the Four Winds!
achievements.description: 在一次风蚀沙虫挑战中，通过冰元素、火元素、雷元素与水元素攻击，分别使风蚀弹触发扩散反应。
achievements.description_en: Use a Cryo, Pyro, Electro, and Hydro attack each to trigger a Swirl reaction with the Windbite Bullets in a fight against the Setekh Wenut.
achievements.series_master_title_en: Now That's What You Call the Four Winds!

achievements.title: 即便存在隔阂…
achievements.description: 在不破坏深罪浸礼者的元素护罩的情况下，将其击败。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the Iniquitous Baptist without destroying its Elemental Ward.

achievements.title: 穷举法则
achievements.description: 击败所有元素能力组合的深罪浸礼者。
achievements.description_en: Defeat Iniquitous Baptists of all possible elemental combinations.

achievements.title: 像太阳一般通过
achievements.description: 在阿佩普的绿洲守望者的挑战中，在没有角色承受末日的余波攻击的情况下，将其击败。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the Guardian of Apep's Oasis without any character being attacked by aftershocks of the apocalypse.

achievements.title: 月亮的距离
achievements.description: 在单个重力削减力场中，进行11次下落攻击，命中实验性场力发生装置。
achievements.description_en: Complete 11 Plunging Attacks in a single Gravity Reduction Field, hitting an Experimental Field Generator.

achievements.title: 重力阵线
achievements.description: 不被「引力涟漪」攻击命中的情况下，击败实验性场力发生装置。
achievements.description_en: Defeat an Experimental Field Generator without being hit by a "Gravity Ripple."

achievements.title: 给我套上枷锁，让我甘心毁灭
achievements.title_en: Shackle Me, That I Might Willingly Be Destroyed

achievements.series_master_title: 给我套上枷锁，让我甘心毁灭
achievements.series_master_title_en: Shackle Me, That I Might Willingly Be Destroyed

achievements.description_en: Defeat the Emperor of Fire and Iron while weakened.

achievements.title: 砂砾收藏家
achievements.description: 在千年珍珠骏麟引导「原海古雷」时，在不破坏共鸣珊瑚珠的情况下直接破坏异海珍珠。
achievements.description_en: Break the Xenomare Pearl directly without destroying the Resonant Coral Orb while the Millennial Pearl Seahorse is guiding Hoarthunder.

achievements.title: 我击碎雷霆
achievements.description: 在千年珍珠骏麟尝试重新凝聚异海珍珠时将其击败。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the Millennial Pearl Seahorse while it is attempting to re-construct a Xenomare Pearl.

achievements.title: 剧场消防演练
achievements.description: 在魔像督军举剑释放怒焰冲击时，摧毁其护罩。
achievements.description_en: Destroy the Legatus Golem's Ward before it can lift its blade and unleash its raging, fiery shockwave.

achievements.title: 未兆的封印咒缚
achievements.description: 击败吸收半幻人后正处于强化状态下的水形幻人。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the Hydro Tulpa after it has become enhanced from absorbing Half-Tulpa(s).

achievements.title: 鲸腹中的三日夜
achievements.title_en: Three Days and Nights in the Belly of the Great Fish
achievements.description: 在不被幻形攻击命中的情况下逃离鲸腹。
achievements.description_en: Escape the belly of the beast without being hit at all by the phantasm(s) within.
achievements.series_master_title_en: Three Days and Nights in the Belly of the Great Fish

achievements.title: 「吉位！」
achievements.description: 一次挑战中，通过元素反应，使隐山猊兽分别在汇集风元素与水元素的仙力时陷入瘫痪状态。
achievements.description_en: Within a single challenge, use Elemental Reactions to paralyze the Solitary Suanni while it is gathering Anemo and Hydro adeptal energy respectively.

achievements.title: 若你渴盼鲜血…
achievements.description: 在一次「仆人」挑战中，释放四次血汐冲击。
achievements.description_en: Unleash 4 Scarlet Nighttides in a single battle against The Knave.

achievements.title: 白之契约者
achievements.description: 在一次「仆人」挑战中，不曾在具有生命之契的情况下被她的攻击命中，并击败「仆人」。
achievements.description_en: In a single battle against The Knave, avoid being hit by her at all while being affected by a Bond of Life and defeat The Knave.

achievements.title: 「空中攻击并不总能成功」
achievements.title_en: "The Bomber Will Not Always Get Through"
achievements.description: 在一次挑战中，破坏过两次金焰绒翼龙暴君发射出的「炽风翎羽」。

achievements.series_master_title_en: "The Bomber Will Not Always Get Through"

achievements.description_en: Use an exploding Flamegranate to defeat the Gluttonous Yumkasaur Mountain King.

achievements.description: 在秘源机兵·构型械处于瘫痪状态时，将其击败。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the Secret Source Automaton: Configuration Device while it is stunned.
achievements.series_master_title_en: "It Is Too Late for You, Inorganics."

achievements.title: 殊形之龙…
achievements.description: 分别在深邃摹结株复现古岩龙蜥、翠翎恐蕈以及千年珍珠骏麟的形象时，将其击败。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the Tenebrous Papilla while it is replicating the forms of a Primo Geovishap, a Jadeplume Terrorshroom, and the Millennial Pearl Seahorse respectively.

achievements.title: 还好我技高一筹
achievements.title_en: Good Thing I'm a Cut Above
achievements.description: 在一次挑战中，累计破坏过灵觉隐修的迷者制造出的8个浮彩分身。
achievements.description_en: Destroy a total of 8 Radiant Reflections created by the Wayward Hermetic Spiritspeaker during a single challenge.
achievements.series_master_title_en: Good Thing I'm a Cut Above

achievements.description: 在战场被破坏至最小时，击败蚀灭的源焰之主。
achievements.description_en: Defeat the Lord of Eroded Primal Fire when the battlefield has been reduced to its smallest size.

achievements.description_en: Defeat Local Legend: Ichcahuipilli's Aegis.

achievements.description_en: During the course of completing a single challenge, defeat 10 Nightsoul Warriors during the Trial of Decisions.

achievements.description_en: Defeat Ichcahuipilli's Aegis without being hit by any attacks.

achievements.description_en: Defeat Local Legend: Chimalli's Shade.

achievements.description_en: Defeat Chimalli's Shade without any characters being downed.

achievements.description_en: Defeat Local Legend: Atlatl's Blessing.

achievements.description_en: During the course of completing a single challenge, use Parry to counterattack all of Atlatl's Blessing's power attacks and inflict damage.

achievements.title: 「阿特拉托的佑助」
achievements.description: 在不受到来自「阿特拉托的佑助」的伤害的情况下，将其击败。
achievements.description_en: Defeat Atlatl's Blessing without taking any damage from attacks.

achievements.title: 「铜锁」
achievements.description: 战胜地方传奇「铜锁」。
achievements.description_en: Defeat Local Legend: Bronzelock.

achievements.description_en: Defeat Bronzelock after Bronzelock has increased RES to 4 different Elemental Types.

achievements.description_en: Defeat Local Legend: Rilai.

achievements.title: 「莉莱」

achievements.title: 「陨落的晨星之灵」

achievements.description_en: Defeat Local Legend: The Peak.

achievements.description_en: Defeat Local Legends: Battlegoat and Ironclaw.
